reviews.text:
Dr. Montelongo and Dr. Trust, along with their staff are AMAZING😎
I have 3 Chihuahuas and they have  all been seen by either Doctors. I have been very satisfied with their care and I would personally recommend EAGLE VETERINARY HOSPITAL🥰 …
Friendly and accommodating

Had to put my cat down.

They were professional and caring.  I was grateful for how they did everything.

Dr. Trust diagnosed our fur baby with diabetes and came up with a reasonable treatment plan and follow ups. With the success of this treatment, our fur baby is doing very well. Thank you Dr. Trust and folks at EVH.
The staff at Eagle Veterinary go above and beyond caring for your pets. They have compassion and knowledge that your pet is scared. They are very good at what they do.

Our first visit here with the Clinic was extremely SUPERB.  I was very 'impress from the time I walked in, which I took our little cat 😺
>∆,,∆<  Fifur, which she did very well by the way.

The technician, I believe her name was Abby, she was excellent 👍

The (front receptionist) had a very cute haircut and was excellent as well.

The doctor was thorough and diligent...

I can not begin to explain my over all gratitude for them helping spunky especially Dr. Montelongo. With his recommendation and the help of his very friendly and supportive staff, my best friend of 13 years is making an amazing recovery. He took him in as a walk in and gave him the best care I could ask for. If you have the opportunity to visit this clinic I would definitely recommend going and have them take care of our four legged family.

My wife and I came in because our little pup was itching her ear and shaking her head a lot. We called and they were happy to get us in the same day. As soon as we entered we were warmly greeted and felt right at home in the cozy comfortable clinic. Lakin, Mikayla, and Dr. Montelongo were all super helpful and kind. They quickly figured out the issue, were very friendly and clear when explaining everything, and took wonderful care of us and our pups. We would highly recommend Eagle Veterinary Hospital to everyone!
Easy & efficient appointment for my dog's vaccinations.
Always caring and attentive.
How is it possible a cat was given a clean bill of health in February and passes from cancer in May. A disgusting oversight in "care" by this staff.
Awesome and very friendly and knowledgeable staff. Would recommend! AAAA+++++
Very knowledgeable and compassionate people, treated my dogs very well, would highly recommend!
Dr. Montelongo is awesome - explains everything thoroughly and helping my cat big time. All of the staff are wonderful and kind. Easy to book appointments online. Would absolutely recommend.

These guys are AMAZING !! My cat was literally on deaths doorstep due to liver toxicity, compromised breathing, and severe weight loss. They worked with me and what treatment I could afford. 5 days later thanks to their expert care she is 85% recovered. Her breathing has returned to normal, all of the toxins have left her system, and she is eating normally and gaining weight back. I cannot thank Eagle Veterinary enough for all they did. Tiger Lilly and I are extremely grateful.
Very nice place with very nice staff. I think my doggy likes it too. :-)

I first started coming here with my rabbit Berry. They did such an amazing job and I got him neutered here without incident. Then we started bringing our labradoodle Vivi and the same great experience. They both show no signs of anxiety when they go and that tells me all I need to know

UPDATE******
4/2026 EXTREMELY disappointed to see a new sign saying they wont take prescriptions from places that aren't their pharmacy. Their prices are EXTREMELY high in comparison and now no choice?
It was a great experience. We have used them for our adopted 6 year old tabby for several.years.

They were wonderful with my dog who is suffering from hip dysplasia. She was not their regular patient but was able to fit her in and treated her so well!  I wish they were not far from me so I could continue taking her there.
They're very respectful hurry gentle with my family and my and my furry animal I give them the highest eval that I can hear.

I was able to get a Saturday appointment for my cat who had injured his paw. He can be VERY fractious at the vet so he has to be sedated to be examined. Dr.Curtis and her team were so patient and understanding about all of my concerns. I truly appreciate everything they did for my pet

Horrible experience.  Made 2 appointments 2 Saturdays in a row for heart worm tests for my 3 schnauzers but they had run out of them each time I showed up.  Didn't bother to call me in advance saying they ran out.  They said they couldn't help me or guarantee there would be tests there next time.  I miss Dr. Kirlin, but since he has retired, it has not been the same.  Looking for another vet now.  I DO NOT RECOMMEND THIS PRACTICE!
Always wonderful with our furry family members!

We have been using Eagle Veterinary Hospital for several years now for our little dog Pepper.  We have had the pleasure of working with both Dr. Trust and Dr. Montelongo. They are both fablous and give that "extra care" when needed. I tend to be alittle obsessive when it comes to care for our boy and they are always so accommodating towards me. They answer ALL my questions and honeslty are both real with me about numerous situations.  They are both very deep thinkers and think outside of the box.  If you are looking for a new vet, give them a try.  They know their field very well!
Whatever gentleman is working, the phones made a choice to keep me on hold for 24 minutes then hang up on me I assume for the fact that they close at 5:30. This is very unfortunate. Do better please
Very knowledgeable and very courteous they genuinely love animals

I personally work in the veterinary industry but not at this clinic and I still make the trek across town to bring my pets to this clinic. I have seen both Dr Curtis and Dr Montelongo who have been absolutely amazing. Dr Curtis compassionately guided our family through the final stages of palliative care for our boy Chevy. Dr Montelongo is working with us to ensure that our other senior dog remains cancer free. The technicians are FANTASTIC. My standards for veterinary care are very high and this clinic ALWAYS goes above and beyond. I love this clinic.
great vet! was my first time coming to the vet eve for my first dog and they were very helpful and answered all my questions and concerns with ease!
Doctor Curtis and staff were amazing! They were quick efficient and affordable.

They are always so kind and patient with us and our pups, especially our dog with epilepsy. We’ve had nothing but good experiences with every staff member at this clinic! They’re also very up front about pricing which has been so helpful for us.
Customer service is great. They help my dog right away. The vet was very nice to my dog and us. She was upfront, but their cost is very high.
Same day service and quick! Highly recommend :)

The assistant and front desk were so kind and helpful for a first time owner answered all my questions but I didn't not appreciate how eye ointment was 65$ here and the exact same onintment was online its only $29 , completely overpriced services and taking advantage of the love we have for our animals. It should be about care not money!
They told us that it was free for the wellness exam but they noticed that something was wrong with our dog and changed it to a half off illness visit! This place is perfect and so accommodating!
The first visit was affordable with a discount for new patients. The gave my dog the medication he needed and he is better now. Thank you Eagle Vet.
We brought our stray here and got him fully checked out! They were super professional and knew exactly what to do, will always be coming here for treatments!

Loved this place for the first time.  Doctor was very helpful tips on how to help my pug ace with his allergy. Nurse and receptionist were very nice better then city vet on Broadway and Castle hills. I found the right place for my bby ace. No attitude no dirty looks. Thank you eagle veterinary hospital.
Came in for my cat Kiki for a bad ear infection. They went over options and pricing before every step. Will come back for future visits with Dr. Curtis.

I have been hesitant about finding a new vet, but Eagle Veterinary pretty much jumped out at me. I gave it a try and was not disappointed⁉️ The staff is incredible and yes, I can absolutely see why Jayden is employee of the month! He is just fantabulous! Sweet, personable, and most importantly knowledgeable. He has the passion! Dr Curtis was also incredible! Thank you for Shylohs journey to recovery!!

I went to Eagle veterinary for a first time visit for my cat. My cat had a serious skin infection on her neck. Mocha 🐈 was treated by Dr Curtis and the entire staff were very friendly, knowledgeable and treated my cat with kindness and compassion. Staff even followed up after the visit.hapoy to report she is doing much better now. I will return to Eagle Veterinary in the future and highly recommended them as well

Took my baby girl Luna to this place Monday! They are absolutely amazing! From the ladies in the front office to the Vet Techs and Vet! They are all joyful amazing people! Really helped me with my baby girl's care and put me at ease! Answered every question I had!

Just be honest with people the ad says free first time exam so I go by and it's not a free exam because my dog is scratching or sick as they stated so I'm like false advertising so only healthy dogs get the free exam 🤔 TF …
Super friendly and very helpful. They will walk you through what they need to do.
Expert care n a friendly atmosphere!

Amazing service you get a complimentary coffee and water bar while u wait and super cute cat and dog magazines in the waiting room and the decor in the rooms is so hashtag gorgeous. Friendly staff and amazing deals.

I’ve taken my dog here for about a year, including for physical exams and a few bouts of kennel cough. Great location, knowledgeable staff and very friendly techs who are great at calming my anxious dog down.

Very professional facility, easy to set appointment online, appointments were on schedule, the process with the technicians was thorough, Dr Trust did a great job with initial first appointment as well as the follow up, secondary appointment.
Very friendly staff. And very helpful.  Recommend coming her for pet needs

All good! Minnie did very well after surgery to remove a lump from her chest. Once her anesthesia wore off, she was her perky self, even the few days she was on pain meds. And her incision healed beautifully. We are very happy with Minnie's treatment at Eagle Veterinary Hospital.💛 …

This is my first time to Eagle Veterinary Hospital. They did really well with Mia. The staff and the veterinarian, Dr Curtis, were all very personable and informative. I like that they were not in a hurry, but make sure to take time to explain things and answer all my questions.
This is a great veterinarian hospital.  They are very helpful in explaining the treatment options and plans available to meet your care needs.  One of the best veterinarian hospitals we have visited.
Dr Montelongo is very caring and professional.  All of the staff provide great care.  Wait time is minimal and easy to get a timely appointment.
So helpful with our Staffordshire terrier Miley by keeing her happy and comfortable❤️

I interacted with 4 employees overall. The doctor and the two technicians were very personable, did not seemed rushed at all, and treated Roxie like she was queen getting shots :-) the girl at the front desk was very personable also. I would definitely go to this vet again. Also, no vet is inexpensive. But I did get a first time discount and a military discount so that made the pain a little bit more tolerable.
They have taken care of my previous pets and my new kitten is in great hands.🙌 Thank you Eagle Veterinary Hospital for being so amazing with my fur-babies.
Dr Montelongo and his team are amazing!!! They are extremely thorough with bullies!
Dr. Montelongo is great! He's very knowledgeable and is great with our cat, Picard. The rest of the staff is very welcoming and kind as well!
Caring, trustworthy and patient Vet… Staff is amazing.

I had been worried about one of my cats, and this veterinary helped ease my mind! They sent me home with some medicine I had no idea even existed and could have helped my cat a while back! Not only that but the doctor also gave me diet suggestions for my cat. It was really great knowing my cat would be okay!

I love this practice! Everyone here is so nice, calm, empathetic. I love the large waiting room with lots of light and seating. It never feels packed which keeps my cats calm as we wait our turn. It feels warm and welcoming even though it’s a doctors office. When we’re in the back, they’re kind enough to let my kitties sniff about the room. Dr Trust and staff always greet them with lots of pets and kind words. When kitties are happy, mama is happy!

We have been coming to Eagle Veterinary for years and we have had such a great experience every time. The staff and doctors are so personable, and have gone above and beyond in care and treatment. Their tech Cody is amazing and super helpful.
Great and friendly staff! I feel safe taking my pets here.

Eagle Veterinary did a great job caring for my dog's ears during a recent visit. For a dog that hates anyone touching his ears, Eagle worked with me on a method for getting my dog just what he needed! Thanks, Eagle Vet!
Super professional and clean. Easy to get an appointment and they are QUICK and timely which is much appreciated.
They are so great from both front desks. This is a important place I take my CesarChavez.
Everyone always helpful and caring I will recommend my family and friends to bring their pets to eagle veterinary

Eagle Vet is the best place to take you fur babies.  Everyone on staff was nice and helpful.  Rep Valerie greets and checks you in and remember your fur baby name. Dr. Curtis she is AMAZING! Answer questions and listens to concerns. She doesn't speed thru appt. She takes her and give full attention to you.  I love it here!!!
I brought my cat here for an eye infection and they were very thorough, careful, and kind. The medication they prescribed worked effectively. Will definitely return!

The staff is great don’t get me wrong but the vets treat people like they have unlimited funds. my daughter took our dogs in just to get a heartworm test because that’s required to get the extremely expensive simperica trio. and look at one of them for a skin rash. Turns out just an allergy but loaded my daughter with expensive soothing shampoos and vitamins and such  that are way overpriced. 60.00 for fish oil!!?!? I could have got that at any store or online for 10 times less. But they don’t offer that option at all.  Bill was $500.00 and that did not include the flea/tick/heartworm prevention medicine. They make you order that online yourself  through a 3rd party and wait for two weeks to get it shipped and let’s just say they don’t offer the best deals on meds. And on top of it I Got charged a waste fee and a technician fee for my dog that just needed the test to get the medicine. A month before this I took same dog in for checkup and routine boosters and that was a whopping $300.00.  I compared the avg regional cost to what they charge on their services and products and they are above the highest average. I’m gonna have to look for a different vet because this place is gouging my wallet.
Dr Curtis took time to explain every detail of the process to get Luna back to herself after extraction.

I truly love this vet office. They treat my pets so well and they are so nice and patient. They take their time to explain treatment and every single person I have interacted with is so kind. We have 4 pets (2 cats and 2 dogs) so we have had a lot of vet experiences, Eagle surpasses them all!
definitely will bring my other animals here, i loved my experience, staff was very efficient, helpful and nice!
We have been bringing our cat here for the past few months. The staff is very nice, helpful and professional. Dr. Curtis has provided great care for our Oscar.

Mochi has been coming here since a pup. As a vet tech in my past life and working w many Vets I can confirm that the front office, vet techs and doctors are as solid as they come. I know Mochi is in good hands 🙌 …
Brought my cat Smudge for her yearly check up.  She's not the nicest of cats, but the staff handled her well. She always gets great care here.
We've been taking our kitties to see Dr. Montelongo for years. The service has always been superior. I wound highly recommend Eagle for your little furry kiddos
The staff at Eagle Vet are awesome!!! They always take great car of my fur babies!!!”
The staff was great! Had someone follow up calls that didn’t happen. Overall a great place with Veterinarians and staff who care.
We’ve been here since Beau Marley was a puppy, 5 years later we are still happy with his care.
We love eagle vet. They always take the utmost care for our pets. The staff are friendly and knowledgeable. I highly recommend eagle vet.

I bring both my corgi mix Kiki and sphynx Chiquita here. Everyone is super friendly. Anyone with a corgi knows that they are high energy and everyone is patient and sweet to her.

They have specials all the time which is always a plus when it comes to the vet. I definitely recommend!
The staff is always super friendly, informative and caring.
The staff and veterinarians are wonderful and compassionate. Scheduling is straightforward and always timely. Highly recommended.
Girl who answers the phone was incompetent and rude
Eagle veterinary hospital is our favorite vet! My dog gets super anxious and they do an amazing job keeping her calm and comfortable
The staff are so friendly and respectful! And they do a great job on the nail trims for my dogs!
Excellent customer service vets take the time to explain everything well highly recommend. Very friendly and knowledgeable

I have been a customer for years and while the doctor care is good the front desk operations is frustrating and unapproachable.  The most odd thing is they will totally ignore you when you walk in until they are ready to greet you.  On two occasions they have messed up with scheduling.  Their prices are the highest in the area and I wouldn’t mind paying them if I knew I was receiving top notch service all the way around but that is not the case.
great fast service, also helpful suggestions if youre working on a budget

Veterinarian Erik Montelongo and Assistant Victoria have made our visit today, feel so important and heard that we and Urth feel comfortable hanging out while we get our plan ready for her lifestyle change. I can’t thank you guys enough you have made myself less stressed and more informed of the possible issues that can arise with having an adult canine. Simply the best plan, the best vets, the best price and best accommodations available. Can’t beat a place that is passionate and knowledgeable in what they do. Made it an easy appt on my end, thank you!
Got my boy healed up! Great staff!

Probably the best vet my family and I’ve been too. Everyone is super friendly and informative and I feel like I’m getting my money’s worth. They helped my 13 year old dachshund who suddenly couldn’t walk in his back legs due to a disc problem and made him able to walk again! Thank you guys a lot for all that you do ❤️

When we arrived, there was a very warm welcome. The office is very clean and tidy.  My dog and (cat that I took before) were very comfortable. The vet took time to talk to me about issues I was having with my dog.
I have been bringing my pets here for many years!! Will continue to bring my pets here for many more years 😊 …
The staff has always been so kind and calm with our big nervous dog! We’ve been taking her here since she was a puppy and they have always been reliable.
Great service and attention to detail. Very friendly!

21 November 2024,
DO NOT TAKE YOUR PET HERE. Dr. Curtis and her team were good but the service from the front desk and how they handle business is Horrible!

Update to my last post. My last visit here, I was told to take my dog to Mission Vet emergency as there was nothing more they could do for him so I did.

A few weeks ago I spoke with Cody the lead tech there about cancelling my dog’s plan since he has gotten very ill and now has passed. Cody told me that he spoke with the manager about this and said I would not be charged for the rest of the plan.

The front desk girls keep calling me and threatening me with paying an amount that I was just made aware of a week and a half ago. After I was told that I didn’t have to pay anything.

I do not appreciate their negative and harassing tone when they call and leave messages, especially when I called and told them last week, my dog just passed and I would be in to pay this amount, but since they keep continuing to call and leave harassing phone calls, I need to have the manager contact me!

Same issues with these rude girls as before.
————————————/——-

I have been trying to reach the office to speak with a manager and each time I called, either the person left me on hold for over 10 mins or they were rude and rushed me off the phone. I just need to see what I need to do cancel my dog’s plan there. A manager needs to contact me as soon as possible or I will be stopping by.

I want to Thank Dr. Curtis and her team for taking good care of my lil dog Squirt. He is a 13 yo chi-mix with some pressing health issues. I learned a lot from them relating to my pet as well and that speaks volumes. I am now focused on his quality of life going further and we will miss this team. Thank You Again!
Excellent service! If there were more stars 🌟 I'd give it 1000. They treated me with great care, without even looking at the price first. They gave me options for my kitten's treatment. …
The friendliest staff and best care in town.
Staff and doctors are very professional and caring.  They answer my questions and offer information and advice to make sure my cat lives a healthy life.  Thank you Dr Montalongo and Cody!.

My Siberian Husky named Misha was seen by Dr. Trust on 9/28/24 and the visit went amazing! Dr. Trust was extremely knowledgeable, answered all my questions, and Misha did great as well. Their staffing is very sweet and helpful, I highly recommend them for veterinary care. Thank ya’ll again!

Wonderful staff and environment. They answered all of my questions and provided great information. So glad we chose Eagle Vet!
Annabelle gives ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Dr. Trust is an excellent Veterinarian at Eagle! He is very thorough in diagnosing and staff is excellent providing great customer service.
Very caring and detail oriented vet service. We have been going for three years and have had just great experiences and interactions with doctors and front of house staff.
